lane: Persona chat: send the person's chosen name to the guide (CH-13)
goal: Owner decision 04/11: the guide may receive the person's chosen name (nickname) in persona chat so it can address them. Send it as one bounded, sanitized line in the Allowed User Context block, and change the Profile hint that currently promises the name is never sent to AI.
successCriteria: The app sends profile.nickname in persona chat userContext; an empty name is omitted.

The server keeps at most 40 characters on one line, drops control characters and the characters [ ] = < > { } so the name cannot open a new prompt block, and adds userName=<name> to the Allowed User Context with an instruction to use it only as a form of address.
The Profile hint says the name is shown on Today and sent to the guide in chat (vi and en).
Deno test for the sanitizer passes; persona chat passes deno check; app tests and tsc pass; backend contract validation passes.
untouchedSurfaces: Council, Daily and Tarot do not receive the name in this slice.
No memory across sessions; no SQL.

impact.entryPoint: Persona chat send in App.tsx and the persona prompt assembler.
impact.dataWrite: No new stored field; the name travels in the request and the model prompt only.
impact.backendContract: Optional userContext.nickname added; old clients keep working.
impact.adminVisibility: Redacted traces keep the prompt redaction rules; catalog digests refreshed.
impact.privacySafety: A chosen name is personal data sent to OpenRouter ZDR endpoints (phase 0). Data safety and the privacy policy must list it; noted for the Owner.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy ai-persona-chat.
